From analysis in performance

Together, these results confirm that jointly leveraging in-the-wild and generator-driven data within a continual learning strategy allows the model to adapt to newly emerging generators while preserving real-world robustness and avoiding catastrophic forgetting..
Under continual adaptation  Online RINE improves average AUC over its baseline by +3.49% after the first round and reaches its peak by the final round with a +7.36% average AUC gain and +20.14% accuracy improvement on AIGenImages2026, while also strengthening in-the-wild robustness along the way (+3.30% AUC on Deepfake-Eval by the second round).
